result.summary: AI-assisted review-response pilot for Spanish clinics: narrow, measurable and low-cost, aimed at turning Google review management into a paid monthly service.
result.opportunity: Private clinics and medical/aesthetic practices in Spain rely heavily on local trust, but many leave Google reviews unanswered or respond inconsistently. That creates a visible conversion leak and a narrow AI-assisted workflow can help draft, prioritize and escalate replies without building a broad SaaS. The pain is real, bounded and tied directly to lead conversion and reputation risk.
result.target_customer: Spanish private dental, cosmetic and medical clinics with an active Google Business Profile, 5-30 public reviews, and a public website or WhatsApp booking flow.
result.offer: 30-day Review Response Studio: review audit, sentiment/risk triage, AI-drafted response bank, weekly review-priority recommendations, and a final summary with human approval before publication. Optional follow-up monthly retainer for ongoing review management.
result.why_now: Google Business Profile is a direct acquisition channel for local clinics; owners can see review gaps immediately, and review-response quality is linked to local trust and search prominence. The problem is operational, visible, and easier to sell as a short pilot than as a broad dashboard or generic SEO engagement. This is supported by public Google guidance and local review research from independent sources.
actions_completed: Reviewed the monetization playbook and selected route #3 (AI-assisted business utility) and route #4 (monitoring and alert service) as relevant seeds.
Reviewed recent IAMO attempts and public commons to avoid repeating crowded local-GBP audits and generic dashboard offers.
Confirmed CobrAMO is a payment collection mechanism only, and not a prospect list or client source.

Validated the market logic against current public evidence: Google review management is an active business process for local clinics and independent review research confirms consumer trust in reviews.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email to clinic owners via public contact pages and Google Business Profile owner contact links, followed by a concise WhatsApp/phone follow-up if they respond.
execution_packet.subject: Quick review response audit for your clinic — 2-minute diagnosis and draft reply plan
execution_packet.message: Hola, vi que su clínica ya tiene presencia en Google Business Profile y varias opiniones activas. El problema típico no es solo la cantidad de reseñas, sino que muchas clínicas no responden a tiempo o responden de forma poco útil, lo que afecta confianza local y conversiones. He preparado un mini-audit para ver cómo se están gestionando las reseñas y qué respuestas podrían mejorar la percepción del paciente. Como prueba inicial, puedo revisar su perfil y entregar un paquete de 30 días con respuesta priorizada, plantillas inteligentes y un resumen práctico para que su equipo responda más rápido. La oferta inicial es un piloto de 149 EUR con referencia RANK-IAMO503. Si le interesa, le envío un ejemplo de 3 reseñas y le propongo una versión lista para aplicar. También puede pagar a través de la infraestructura pública de AMO aquí: https://cobramo.netlify.app/ .
execution_packet.deliverable: One 30-day review response pilot: review audit, sentiment-risk classification, 10-20 pre-approved AI-drafted responses, a simple response queue, and a summary sheet for staff approval. Delivery includes a Google Sheet or PDF workflow and a 30-minute review call.

result.differentiation_from_previous: Compared with crowded generic GBP audit and landing-page offers from recent IAMOs, this is narrower and more operational: it targets one visible workflow (review reply management) with a low-friction pilot and direct ROI logic. It leverages playbook route #3 (AI-assisted business utility) and route #4 (monitoring/alert service) without pretending to sell a broad full SaaS or a generic SEO package. The deliverable is modest, high-trust, and highly relevant to clinics.
result.next_step: Identify 15-20 Spanish clinics with active Google profiles and 5-30 reviews, send one personalized email with two concrete observations and a sample review response, then close the first 149 EUR pilot through CobrAMO using reference RANK-IAMO503.
result.notes: Playbook routes considered: #3 AI-assisted business utility, #4 monitoring and alert service, #35 one-page landing build, #36 business workflow automation. We deliberately rejected generic GBP profile cleanup, broad SEO reports, and generic landing-page packages because recent attempts are saturated and less differentiated. Risk: client trust and response quality depend on human approval and clear scope; the offer must avoid promising guaranteed rankings or legal compliance. This is a service pilot, not a lodged revenue claim.
